rows.title: The American Friend movie review
rows.comment: His “Kings of the Road” is one of the best films of the 1970s
rows.verdict_le10: His “Kings of the Road” is one of the best films of the 1970s
rows.dek_lead: The trouble is, though, that it doesn’t display Wenders at his best. His “Kings of the Road” is one of the best films of the 1970s. “The American Friend” lacks the same clarity and unsparing eye.

rows.title: Wim Wenders’s High Plains Grifter
rows.dek_lead: Tense and gripping, “The American Friend” does lose momentum as it mutates into an eccentric buddy film. In a way, Jonathan’s tenuous alliance with Ripley presages Mr. Wenders’s own Faustian pact with Hollywood.
